ineligible.History: levels (0, 1, 2), not (0, k); reads the categorical string 'Suspicion History' (slightly/moderately/highly suspicious), not a boolean finding
ineligible.EKG: levels (0, 1, 2), not (0, k); reads the categorical string 'Electrocardiogram Test' (normal / non-specific repolarization disturbance / significant ST deviation)
ineligible.Age: kind is numeric, not a finding
ineligible.Risk factors: levels (0, 1, 2), not (0, k); points come from a count over seven boolean keys (0 / 1-2 / >=3 or atherosclerotic disease), so affirming one risk factor adds points only when the count crosses a band and no single noun phrase settles the item under the score text
ineligible.Initial troponin level: levels (0, 1, 2), not (0, k); reads the categorical string 'Initial troponin' (<= normal limit / 1-3x / >3x), not a boolean finding
